results.title: Deadfall Arithmetic
results.overview: A forestry accountant realises the numbers in a logging ledger describe something other than trees.

results.title: Bitter Orange
results.overview: A citrus inspector uncovers a grove that produces perfect fruit and no records of anyone planting it.

results.title: The Last Analogue Signal
results.overview: The final terrestrial broadcast tower on Earth is scheduled for demolition, and someone is still transmitting from it.

results.title: Pocket Universe
results.overview: A child's shoebox diorama turns out to have weather, and then history, and then opinions about being observed.

results.title: Every Exit Is An Entrance
results.overview: An architect who designs escape routes for a living cannot find a way out of a conversation with her mother.

results.title: The Cartographer's Daughter
results.overview: A mapmaker's daughter retraces her father's final expedition using only his annotated charts, and finds the blank spaces were deliberate.

results.title: Understudy
results.overview: A stand-in learns every one of a leading actress's habits, then keeps performing them after the production wraps.

results.title: Rust Belt Sonata
results.overview: A shuttered piano factory's last tuner keeps servicing instruments that no longer have owners.

results.title: Ultraviolet Catastrophe
results.overview: A physicist chasing an anomaly in blackbody radiation finds the discrepancy is a message, and it is very old.

results.title: Common Fisheries Policy
results.overview: Rival trawler crews discover the disputed waters they have fought over for a decade contain nothing at all.

results.title: Provenance Unknown
results.overview: An art authenticator stakes her reputation on a painting whose history begins, verifiably, three weeks ago.

results.title: Hollowpoint
results.overview: A retired armourer is pulled back in when the weapons she built start appearing at crime scenes she can date to the day.

results.name: Hedgerow
results.overview: Neighbours in a village where every boundary predates the records that would settle them.

results.name: Terminal Moraine
results.overview: A glaciologist's team documents a retreating ice sheet and finds that what it uncovers is being catalogued by someone else first.

results.name: The Switchboard
results.overview: Night operators at a 1960s telephone exchange hear a call that has not been placed yet, and keep listening.

results.name: Statute of Limitations
results.overview: A cold case unit works only files about to expire, deciding daily which injustices to let go.

results.name: Fair Use
results.overview: An overworked copyright tribunal adjudicates increasingly metaphysical claims about who owns a memory.

results.name: The Commons
results.overview: Six families share one field for one season, and negotiate everything from first principles.

results.name: Dead Reckoning
results.overview: A delivery skipper navigating without instruments, and the increasingly generous definition of 'roughly on course'.

results.name: The Anthropic Principle
results.overview: A cosmology department discovers their observations only work if someone is watching, and takes shifts.
